items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-15
items.q: This professional singer who sang with George Hall and many named bands around the country.

ctx.x: No, he didn't sing, but he played a driving trumpet. He married Loretta Lee. I see. This professional singer who sang with George Hall and many named bands around the country. Her name was Margaret Villegas, and she just recently passed away within the last six, eight months of it.
I, I, I, I'm curious whether they added a, well you know they called them boy singers and girl singers in. Would they add any boy singers? Well they call them vocalists, so.
